claims.claim: Section 88 of the Income Tax Ordinance (definition of "מדד", index): for a security held by an individual that is denominated in foreign currency or linked to it, the currency rate is treated as the index. So the cost of a foreign-broker share is adjusted by the change in the exchange rate, not by the CPI.
claims.raw_snippet: על אף האמור, לענין נייר ערך בידי יחיד, הנקוב במטבע חוץ או שערכו צמוד למטבע חוץ, יראו את שער המטבע כמדד

claims.claim: Section 88 defines the inflationary amount (סכום אינפלציוני) as the part of the capital gain equal to the excess of the adjusted original-price balance over the original-price balance, and real capital gain as the capital gain less the inflationary amount.
claims.raw_snippet: חלק ריווח ההון השווה לסכום שבו עולה יתרת המחיר המקורי המתואם על יתרת המחיר המקורי

claims.claim: Section 88: real capital gain (ריווח הון ריאלי) is the capital gain less the inflationary amount.
claims.raw_snippet: ריווח הון ריאלי“ - ריווח ההון פחות הסכום האינפלציוני

claims.claim: Section 88 defines a capital loss (הפסד הון) as the amount by which the original-price balance exceeds the consideration, a nominal measure.
claims.raw_snippet: הפסד הון“ - הסכום שבו עולה יתרת המחיר המקורי על התמורה

claims.claim: Section 88: the adjusted original-price balance is the original price multiplied by the index on the sale day and divided by the index on the purchase day.
claims.raw_snippet: כפול במדד ביום המכירה ומחולק במדד ביום הרכישה

claims.claim: Section 88: a substantial shareholder (בעל מניות מהותי) holds at least 10% of any type of means of control in a body of persons, directly or indirectly, alone or together with another.

claims.claim: Section 88: the change date (מועד השינוי) is 1 January 2012.

claims.claim: Section 91(b)(1): an individual pays tax on real capital gain at a rate not exceeding 25%, and the capital gain is treated as the top layer of taxable income.

claims.claim: Section 91(b)(2): real capital gain on the sale of a security in a body of persons by an individual who is a substantial shareholder at the time of sale or at any time in the 12 months before it is taxed at a rate not exceeding 30%.

claims.raw_snippet: ניתן ביום: 12.9.16

claims.claim: As summarised by Alex Shapira and Co. (capitax): under Moses, a capital loss while the index (exchange rate) fell leaves only the real loss; where the index fell and there is a gain, the taxed gain is the smaller nominal shekel gain, because a negative inflationary amount is not taken into account; a loss while the index rose is allowed at its nominal amount. The further-hearing request was denied by President Naor.
